description: Test whether the biochemical defect class of ABAT missense variants tracks their structural distance to PLP, and draw the two-arm causal chain
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research/1.0"})
pdb=S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1OHV.pdb",timeout=120).text
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
rows=[]
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")):
        rows.append((l[:6].strip(),l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),l[21],int(l[22:26]),
                     float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["rec","name","resn","chain","resi","x","y","z"])
OFF=28
ca=A[(A.chain=="A")&(A.name=="CA")&(A.resn.isin(aa3))].drop_duplicates("resi").copy(); ca["pres"]=ca.resi+OFF
cof=A[(A.resn=="PLP")&(A.chain.isin(["A","B"]))][["x","y","z"]].values
XYZ=ca[["x","y","z"]].values
ca["d_plp"]=np.min(np.linalg.norm(XYZ[:,None,:]-cof[None,:,:],axis=2),axis=1)
D=ca.set_index("pres")["d_plp"]

# functional tiers from HEK-293 expression assays, Ambrosini 2025 (PMID 40414180)
tiers=pd.DataFrame([
 ("p.Arg220Lys",220,"catalytic"),("p.Gln296His",296,"catalytic"),("p.Arg377Trp",377,"catalytic"),
 ("p.Pro152Ser",152,"structural + catalytic"),("p.Leu211Phe",211,"structural + catalytic"),
 ("p.Leu478Pro",478,"structural + catalytic"),
 ("p.Arg92Gln",92,"moderate, activity retained"),("p.Phe213Cys",213,"moderate, activity retained"),
 ("p.Gly465Asp",465,"moderate, activity retained"),("p.Gly465Arg",465,"moderate, activity retained"),
],columns=["variant","pos","tier"])
tiers["d_plp"]=tiers.pos.map(D)
cat=tiers.loc[tiers.tier=="catalytic","d_plp"]
struc=tiers.loc[tiers.tier=="structural + catalytic","d_plp"]
mod=tiers.loc[tiers.tier=="moderate, activity retained","d_plp"]
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(cat,struc,alternative="less")
print(tiers.round(1).to_string(index=False))
print(f"\ncatalytic-tier median {cat.median():.1f} A vs structural-tier median {struc.median():.1f} A")
print(f"Mann-Whitney one-sided U={u:.0f}, p={p:.4f} (complete separation, n=3 vs 3; p=0.05 is the exact minimum)")
print(f"moderate tier median {mod.median():.1f} A")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
a=ax[0]
order=["catalytic","structural + catalytic","moderate, activity retained"]
cols=["#c53030","#2b6cb0","#38a169"]
for i,(t,c) in enumerate(zip(order,cols)):
    v=tiers.loc[tiers.tier==t,"d_plp"].values
    a.scatter(np.full(len(v),i)+np.linspace(-.08,.08,len(v)),v,s=70,color=c,zorder=3)
    a.hlines(np.median(v),i-.22,i+.22,color=c,lw=3)
for _,r in tiers.iterrows():
    a.annotate(r.variant.replace("p.",""),(order.index(r.tier),r.d_plp),
               textcoords="offset points",xytext=(9,-3),fontsize=7)
a.set_xticks(range(3)); a.set_xticklabels(["catalytic\ndefect","structural +\ncatalytic","moderate,\nactivity retained"])
a.set_ylabel("CA distance to PLP cofactor (A)")
a.set_title("Biochemical defect class tracks distance to the active site\n(HEK-293 assay classes, PMID 40414180)")
a.grid(alpha=.3,axis="y")

b=ax[1]
mech=["ABAT biallelic\nloss of function","GABA-T activity\nlost in mitochondrial\nmatrix (GO:0005759)",
      "GABA accumulates\n60x in CSF\n(CHEBI:16865)","tonic GABA-A\ninhibition +\nreceptor adaptation",
      "neonatal encephalopathy,\nburst suppression,\nhypersomnolence"]
mech2=["dNDP -> dNTP\nconversion impaired\n(ABAT moonlighting)","mtDNA depletion\nin brain and muscle",
       "respiratory chain\ndeficiency"]
for i,t in enumerate(mech):
    b.annotate(t,(0.12,0.92-0.21*i),xycoords="axes fraction",ha="left",va="center",fontsize=7.5,
               bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.35",fc="#ebf8ff",ec="#2b6cb0"))
    if i<len(mech)-1: b.annotate("",xy=(0.2,0.92-0.21*i-0.085),xytext=(0.2,0.92-0.21*i-0.045),
               xycoords="axes fraction",arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color="#2b6cb0"))
for i,t in enumerate(mech2):
    b.annotate(t,(0.62,0.71-0.21*i),xycoords="axes fraction",ha="left",va="center",fontsize=7.5,
               bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.35",fc="#fffaf0",ec="#dd6b20"))
    if i<len(mech2)-1: b.annotate("",xy=(0.70,0.71-0.21*i-0.085),xytext=(0.70,0.71-0.21*i-0.045),
               xycoords="axes fraction",arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color="#dd6b20"))
b.annotate("",xy=(0.60,0.71),xytext=(0.42,0.71),xycoords="axes fraction",
           arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color="#dd6b20"))
b.set_title("Branch point: neurotransmitter arm and mtDNA arm")
b.axis("off")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
